goalVerdict.japanese: 新系列の独自Tokenizer/人間発話境界と幅比較の実行系は成立し、両幅で短い文と真の発話末尾を学び始めた。しかし有用な内容応答は新両モデル0/32、自己履歴stressも0/4意味成立で、自然な日常対話AIという目標は未達。512更新/約0.148epochから容量の限界や最終モデル規模を決めない。

actualTrainingAccounting.interpretation: The fresh pilot covers2048 of13878 original windows once (~14.76% epoch), not a large or complete Japanese foundation run. Larger model has lower token/parameter exposure. This bounds all negative capacity conclusions.

pairedNewWidthComparison.primaryFrozenFlag: medium at least+4/32 compositeWhole versus small; harmful repetition/invalidUTF8 do not increase; exploratory only, no adoption gate
pairedNewWidthComparison.interpretation: Medium improves teacher-forced prediction at identical consumed data, but the one composite gain is only a minimal acknowledgment case; no content-answer improvement, and harmful short repetition increases. NLL alone cannot establish a better conversational model.

reasons: R46 previously trained on these original TRAIN documents; fresh models hold them out by document/speaker and new Tokenizer fit.
R46 uses old own BPE/plain history; new models use fresh BPE/human-role and utterance-EOS format.
R46 has a different long prior training lineage.
32 new outputs versus23 old outputs must not be compared as if same denominator; use the paired23 and new overall32 separately.
Token NLL differs in segmentation (420new versus605old response-body targets); byteNLL is descriptive canonical-encoding information, not equal-exposure causal ranking.
legacyReference.interpretation: New models make fewer long broken continuations mainly by emitting a minimal acknowledgment almost everywhere. This is a useful format/fluency observation, not proof they understand inputs better than R46 or that width caused old-new differences.

endVsMeaning.structuralVersusBodyPrediction: On64 DEV windows role top1~97.6/98.4%, EOS top1~97.3/97.2%, body top1~5.38/7.01%. Overall-token accuracy is strongly helped by easy role/end targets. Show body separately.
endVsMeaning.interpretation: Every new utterance reaches EOS and is valid UTF8, but no new model supplies content-specific answers. Correct stopping and a natural short phrase cannot stand for semantic understanding. Do not reduce EOS supervision or add output penalties to hide this early body underlearning without a new causal study.

selfplayInterpretation.observed: All24 turns are minimal acknowledgments, repeated across3 forced A/B turns with no meaningful progression. No content/reference use is demonstrated.

raterDefinitionDiscrepancy.ownDefinition: Semantic complete appropriate utterance with true EOS, frozen in own rubric; inappropriate nonanswer does not pass even when grammatical.
raterDefinitionDiscrepancy.modelReviewerDefinition: Actual EOS plus grammatically complete utterance; appropriateness scored separately.
raterDefinitionDiscrepancy.presentation: Use Evaluation Analyst uniform87 rubric for the main across-endpoint comparison. Present other reviewer field as a separately named syntactic/EOS termination diagnostic, not as the same count.
raterDefinitionDiscrepancy.notOutcomeRepair: No existing rating was changed after key disclosure. The difference is a construct definition limitation, not a reason to select the more favorable rate.
raterDefinitionDiscrepancy.concordantResults: Both independent blind readers score new specific-content replies0/32each and new composite counts22/32small and23/32medium. Their naturalTermination counts differ substantially by definition.
raterDefinitionDiscrepancy.futureFix: Predeclare distinct endTokenObserved, utteranceFormComplete, responseSemanticallyComplete and compositeWhole fields before future outputs; audit rubric comprehension on examples outside the formal heldout benchmark.

evaluationCoverageLimits.pilotSingleSource: RealPersona only,32 SHA-selected documents;5 contentRequired and30 contentOpportunity. Not intent-balanced; most inputs permit generic acknowledgments.
evaluationCoverageLimits.formal252Status: Designed only; JP60/REPLY80/CTX40/ROLL72 source stimuli, independent sealed custody and human raters have not been assembled.
evaluationCoverageLimits.globalNewPipelineUnseenScope: The new split/Tokenizer is genuinely TRAIN-only for the fresh models. Once these DEV outputs are exposed, subsequent tuning cannot call the same panel a fresh TEST.
evaluationCoverageLimits.qualityAndLicensing: Existing CC-BY-SA4 human original provenance, speaker/order/boundaries and true end labels retained. This valid provenance does not by itself supply long-prose or all daily-dialogue genre diversity.
evaluationCoverageLimits.humanGold: Gold alone overlaps2 TRAIN utterances as natural common expressions; history+gold exact overlap0. Human private preferences/experiences and unverified source claims are not unique ground-truth semantic answers.

nextEvaluationPriorities.action: Instantiate a content-balanced independent diagnostic panel and prospective formal benchmark from licensed human originals/human authors, before another scored candidate output.
nextEvaluationPriorities.why: The current32 can show generic-mode collapse but has only5 content-required prompts and cannot certify everyday intent response. Preserve current32 as exposed stability DEV; do not tune until it looks good.
details: Questions/explanations/consultation/content-bearing small talk separately balanced; human-defined allowable replies and required content, no gold exact-match demand.
Include real constrained-context/reference pairs where prior history changes a required answer; no hidden personal facts needed to answer.
Use new document/question/speaker families and an exposure ledger, with a genuinely independent sealed counterpart before promotion.
Use independent Japanese human raters for formal milestones, not only assistant judgments.

nextEvaluationPriorities.action: Evaluate a preregistered sufficiently broader coverage/learning curve while keeping width comparison and body/end target accounting controlled.
nextEvaluationPriorities.why: 0.148epoch is too early to decide capacity limits. A first-epoch coverage diagnostic is informative but not a sufficiency rule or an instruction to keep training until loss improves.
details: Freeze matched update/token/coverage checkpoints before outputs and compare contentful whole replies, not only NLL/EOS.
A continuation must explicitly define LR after the current cosine schedule ends; do not silently restart warmup or raise LR by changing total steps.
First-epoch final partialbatch/repeated-window accounting must be explicit; preserve target/sampler comparisons.
Current plan cap is closed; any further run needs a new preregistered resource budget and is not executed by this review.

nextEvaluationPriorities.action: Treat broader modern Japanese prose and authentic conversation diversity as the foundation program; then human-written reply adaptation and actual multi-turn conversation.
nextEvaluationPriorities.why: Valid short human chat alone and structural end markers do not ensure sentence/paragraph composition, content response, intent use or retention. Use data quality/genre audit and actual resource profiling before large training.
details: Do not mechanically repeat loss/EOS coefficient experiments to improve this exposed32.
Do not enlarge solely because512-update replies are generic, or reject larger models because both are early generic.
Report capacity curves at matched data and measured compute, plus multiple seeds when feasible.
Keep human-dialogue-continuation and AI-assistant response modes distinct; fiction persona recall is not AI autobiographical truth.
